tavern.name: The Rusty Flagon
tavern.description: A dimly lit tavern with creaky floorboards. The smell of stale ale hangs in the air. A fire crackles in the corner.

hallway.name: Stone Hallway
hallway.description: A narrow stone corridor. Torchlight flickers on damp walls.

armory.name: Old Armory
armory.description: Rusted weapons line the walls. A few look salvageable.

cellar_stairs.name: Cellar Stairway
cellar_stairs.description: A narrow spiral staircase descends into darkness.

cellar.name: Wine Cellar
cellar.description: Rows of dusty barrels fill the damp cellar. Something shuffles in the dark.

courtyard.name: Castle Courtyard
courtyard.description: Overgrown grass pushes through cracked flagstones. A broken fountain stands in the center.

rusty_key.name: Rusty Key
rusty_key.description: A heavy iron key covered in rust.

torch.name: Wooden Torch
torch.description: A simple torch that provides light.

wooden_shield.name: Wooden Shield
wooden_shield.description: A round wooden shield with iron bands.

health_potion.name: Health Potion
health_potion.description: A small glass vial filled with red liquid.

old_map.name: Faded Map
old_map.description: An old parchment showing the castle layout.

barkeep.name: Greta the Barkeep
barkeep.description: A stout woman with kind eyes and strong arms.

giant_rat.name: Giant Rat
giant_rat.description: A rat the size of a dog. Its eyes gleam red.

wandering_merchant.name: Elric the Merchant
wandering_merchant.description: A thin man in a travel-worn cloak surrounded by trinkets.
